parsing_res_list.block_content: Born in the Dark: LRDs from FDM Solitons
$ N_{e v t} $: Number of events per triggered halo.
•  $ t_{evt}/t_{H} $: The fractional duration of the event relative to the Hubble time.
The observed number density is simply the total halo density weighted by the probability of catching a halo in the active, obscured LRD phase.
